Job Description: Senior AI Platform Engineer (Enterprise Integrations & Agent Platform)

Location: Hyderabad / Indore / Gurgaon (Hybrid)
Experience: 7-12 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time




About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, develop, and scale enterprise-grade AI platforms, intelligent agents, and integrations that transform Software Engineering and Quality Engineering workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, Generative AI technologies, cloud-native applications, and enterprise tool integrations.

In this role, you will be responsible for building AI-powered solutions that drive automation, enhance developer productivity, and enable seamless integration across engineering ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/LLM-powered applications and AI agents.
Build and maintain enterprise integrations with engineering and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, ServiceNow, Confluence, Jenkins, and SonarQube.
Develop REST APIs and microservices using Python and FastAPI.
Design and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions and knowledge retrieval systems.
Create reusable Agent SDKs, AI frameworks, and shared platform capabilities.
Develop and manage MCP Servers and enterprise connectors.
Build, deploy, and manage applications using Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and telemetry capabilities for AI platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable AI solutions.
Drive continuous improvements in engineering productivity through intelligent automation.



Required Skills & Experience

7-12 years of experience in software development and platform engineering.
Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered applications.
Expertise in FastAPI, REST API development, and Microservices architecture.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application deployment.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, and Function Calling.
Experience implementing RAG architectures, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval systems.
Experience integrating with enterprise platforms and development tools.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability frameworks.
Excellent problem-solving and system design skills.



Good to Have

Experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar AI frameworks.
Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and MCP Server development.
Experience designing and implementing Multi-Agent Systems.
Exposure to workflow orchestration and automation platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Teams integrations and VS Code extensions.
Background in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Software Engineering Productivity, or Quality Engineering.
